hardness.label: Hard to Very Hard
hardness.intro: SLCDPU's 2026 water quality report lists 8.0 to 12.4 GPG at its three surface water plants, and more at some wells. Click a community to see what that means for your home.
hardness.reportNote: SLCDPU's 2026 report lists total hardness of 136 mg/L (8.0 GPG) at Big Cottonwood, 175 mg/L (10.2 GPG) at Parleys and 212 mg/L (12.4 GPG) at City Creek, with wells at 154 to 571 mg/L. It gives no single city-wide average, so your street's reading depends on the source blend that reaches it. The USGS rates 121 to 180 mg/L as hard and over 180 mg/L as very hard.
hardness.footnote: Hardness is SLCDPU's 2026 plant-by-plant range, not a city-wide average. Your street can read higher or lower; a free water test shows your tap. Millcreek, Holladay and Cottonwood Heights are served by SLCDPU only in part, so check your water bill for the provider. Figures for the other valley cities are typical readings and vary by provider and zone; a free water test shows your tap.
